game.name: ROBLOX: Entry Point
game.rules:
# **Game Rules**:

**Site Rules apply**

- This is common sense, but **runs without the intention of speedrunning are rejected** (First attempts are acceptable). If this continuously happens by the same person, being banned is plausible.
- This is common sense, but **third-party applications that can give an advantage (macros, shaders, exploits, etc.) are not allowed**. Bloxstrap and its features (such as unlocking fps) are allowed; however, this is subject to change. 

- Only **one POV is required** for a multiplayer run (Dependent on Category [Check Category Rules]); however, multiple POVs are recommended.

- **Glitches are allowed** and are **submitted in the Glitched Category** for the respective LB; however, **runs with patched glitches will be rejected** (Pending and Verified run). Some glitches are banned from being used. **Consult a Moderator about whether or not what you are using (or going to use) is considered a glitch and,** **if so, a banned one.**

- The Roblox language is preferred to be English. **Verifiers can reject a run if certain run aspects cannot be determined due to language.**

# **Video Requirements**:

- Your recording should be at least 15 fps and 360p (30 fps and 480p and higher are preferred).

- It is smart to start recording **before** you spawn.
- Videos or images that take up the majority of your screen or other important areas can result in your run being rejected.
- **Videos must be uploaded to persistent video-sharing sites like YouTube or Twitch Highlights. If they don't natively embed in a Speedrun.com submission, it will most likely be rejected (Medal.tv and Streamlabs are exceptions).**

- The endscreen must be on the screen long enough for moderators to pause and see it.

- Sound isn't required, but it's preferred.

# Submission Requirements:

- **This game has a built-in timer, which will be the time you use to submit.** Some categories require an outside timer, which, in most cases, would have the Verifier timing your run (but having a timer is nice).
- Uploading runs from other people is **not** allowed.
- Videos **must** meet all Video Requirements.
- Runs **must** meet all the requirements for the game and category being submitted to.
- Submissions **must** follow all other site rules.
- Wait at least **7 days** before DMing a moderator regarding the status of your run. **We are volunteers, and we have lives.**
- Moderators may ask for additional requirements or lessen the requirements for a run, but this wouldn't be common.

## **By submitting a run, you acknowledge having read these rules and agree to adhere to them. Any infractions towards the rules could result in a rejection of your submission.**

newsList.title: The Official Server For All Freefall Softworks Pages
newsList.body: - This is a pretty big announcement for speedrunning because EEPC, as of 10/24/2022, is now the official server for **ALL** of Freefall Softworks speedrun pages and future ones that are added. This includes (as of right now), Entry Point (and Category Extensions [CE]), Deception, Glass, and Facade.

Fill in all the containers (Dumpster, Chest, etc) of the map, and complete the mission.
In other words : everything that can hide bodies must be full before you finish the mission.

categories.name: Pierre%
categories.rules:
1. Timer starts when "Characters" is clicked
2. Everything on your character must be different before starting (Hair, Hair color, Outfit, and shades)
3. Must have the 'Lucky' codename
4. Timer stops when "Apply" is clicked

For "New Operative" you need to create a new operative insted of editing an existant one.

categories.name: Lvl.60
categories.rules:
Xp grind from lvl 1 to lvl 60.
Timer starts when the 1st mission/match starts and ends when your character reach lvl 60.
Every method is allowed, except shadow war.
Building up pro bonus beforehand isn't allowed, you must start with 0% pro xp bonus.
Using xp boosts from limited time in-game events is not allowed.

categories.name: Badge

(Legend No Kill No Alarm)

categories.rules: Shoot every targets

- Don't use cams

categories.rules: - Only hostaging. No Kills or knocking out anyone. NPCs killing others do not kill the run and a POV (Point Of View) is required for all runners unless it can be proven from one player’s POV

categories.name: Story%
categories.rules:
Complete every mission included in ironman + Freelancer successfully, but ironman mode isn't allowed.

- Has to be done in the timeline order
- The timer starts when you click the 'Start Chapter' button in the Freelancer mission and ends when on Black Dusk End Screen.
- The Timer can be paused if you exit the game (Roblox as a whole) but must always be on while in-game

categories.name: Story% Multiplayer
categories.rules:
Complete every mission included in ironman, but ironman mode isn't allowed.

- Has to be done in the timeline order
- The timer starts when everyone is  'Ready' in the first mission and ends when on Black Dusk End Screen.

Complete every mission in timeline order. Killhouse and Concept are the last two missions. The order of those two does not matter

- Has to be done in the timeline order
- The timer starts when you click 'Ready' on the first mission
- The Timer can be paused if you exit the game (Roblox as a whole) but must always be on while in-game

categories.name: 100% Multiplayer
categories.rules:
Complete every mission in timeline order. Killhouse and Concept are the last two missions and the order of those two does not matter. Freelancer doesn't need to be played.

- Has to be done in the timeline order
- The timer starts when everyone is 'Ready' on the first mission

categories.name: Freelancer
categories.rules: Timer starts when you click on "Start Chapter" and ends when you escaped (before the cutscene)

categories.name: Genocide
categories.rules:
- Kill everyone without raising the alarm. Except : Civilians & respawned guards. You must kill respawnable guards at least 1 time. Make sure everyone is DEAD, if you accidently hide a living body, your run is dead.
- You must complete the mission after your genocide.
- All POVs (Point of View) are required unless it can be proven through one POV
